sample_unit: LLM-generated patient leaflets (3 LLMs x 3 conditions), compared with 3 NHS leaflets

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRES, Gunning Fog) of LLM-generated patient leaflets vs NHS leaflets
links.effect: NHS FKGL 5.9-6.3, FRES 70.5-72.4; ChatGPT FKGL 6.8-7.2; DeepSeek 8.3-8.7; Gemini 9.7-10.2, often exceeding recommended reading levels.
links.quote: While LLMs, especially ChatGPT, show promise in generating patient information, their outputs remain less readable than professionally authored NHS materials.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-generated patient leaflets relative to recommended patient material levels
links.effect: Gemini FKGL 9.7-10.2 and DeepSeek 8.3-8.7, often exceeding recommended reading levels for patient materials; NHS leaflets FKGL 5.9-6.3.
links.quote: Gemini generated the most complex texts (FKGL: 9.7-10.2), often exceeding recommended reading levels for patient materials.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability metrics of LLM-generated patient information leaflets compared to NHS leaflets without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
